carousel.title: What is DOE?
carousel.body: DOE means the employer sets pay after reviewing your experience. It's flexible—you can aim for the higher end of the market.

carousel.title: DOE Isn't Always Bad
carousel.body: It can attract broader talent and tailor pay to seniority. In fields like AI or healthcare, DOE can push salaries above average.
